# Original animation update 50A850

Both sealed FPU profiles execute 21,896 unique valid-pointer contexts and
26,160 parent calls each, with identical observations. Four additional
lookup-mutation contexts fault in the original and are retained separately.
All 187 root bytes and 833 reached dependency bytes execute (1,020 total).
The declared root and dependency bodies contain 1,098 bytes; the outer NPC attack
shortcut makes weapon helper 4FA280 unreachable. Root padding is excluded.
Selector inline-table reads cover 83 bytes and dynamic frame inputs 48 bytes.

The actual NPC parent 533D00, frame helper 4F9F90, selector 533790,
Mimic/Plant/Zombie predicates and WORD type helper execute. Only dictionary
lookup 4E3830 is declared, returning real type records/nil and applying
specified input mutations. No predicate, animation index or result is supplied.
Inputs include completed/attack shortcuts, signed stack addressing, repeated
calls, byte counter boundaries, lookup mutations and records aliasing sprite
bytes. Complete heap/stack/global/code/FPU guards are observed in the original.

The public C ABI remains char(native_object*). The original AL is an action
or completion byte on shortcuts and the child pointer's low byte otherwise.
The native comparator relocates pointer-derived AL to the actual native
record; literal PE32 pointer bits and unused upper EAX are not an ABI target.
Both full C and direct Go comparisons use actual child/predicate/frame calls,
registered dictionary inputs, ordered callback observations and complete
native input/array/cache/scratch guards. Original store traces remain evidence;
the native comparator checks final memory without claiming store counts.

Twenty-one ordinary binding modes add 42 calls per path through the typed C
entry, public Go method and void Go dispatcher. They use default factories,
actual PlayerDraw parsing, warm type caches and no provider substitution.
Four separate diagnostics per C/Go path require the actual child to return
0x80 after lookup clears the table and the caller to raise a read fault.
The original read is one byte at 0x89. Native fault-PC equivalence is not
claimed, and these malformed inputs are not valid-pointer primary cases.

The independent producer and its static dependency live together in
`monster_animation_update_50a850/`, leaving previous reference inputs intact.
It requires Unicorn 2.1.4 and accepts `--game`, `--fixture`, `--proof` and
`--control` (0xe3f or 0x23f). Use fresh output paths. GAME.EXE SHA-256 is
`0040e2c0683b4d73a5fb976e400d5087dca680df2b195c9e27f8edbda2d4974a`.

The verification ROOT preserves the pre-port C pointer crash, 21,897
allocation/registry controls and the bounded existing Go memory projection:
20,520 selected contexts / 24,224 calls, with 20,344 passing and 176 differing
children. That projection excludes char, child/provider entry and NPC global

All original/comparator inputs were frozen before engine edits. Overall 100%
and the final nine chapter 1–3 audits remain open; chapter 4+ is excluded.
